notes.title: Stop The F Demo Update: Hotfixes & Additions
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Update: HotFixes and additions ([b]optimization[/b] included)

Fixes:[/h1][p]1) AntiHints gameplay fixed 
2) Faster Fan in Test Chamber number 4 for correct cube dropper functionality 
3) Posters misunderstanding fixed (now test chamber 3 exists) 
4) [u]Loud Jazz Limbo fixed[/u] 
5) Oil in cooler (Test Chamber 7) fixed 
6) A lot Erasing Beer Sound fixed 
7) [u]Bug with subtitles language fixed[/u] 
8) A lot Erasing Beer Sound fixed
9) Russian subtitles mistake fixed 
10) [u]Softlock fixed (Test Chamber 1)[/u][/p][h2]Additions:[/h2][p]11) [u]Dropper stickers variations added[/u] 
12) Intro Skippability added (enter) 
13) Fizzler inside elevator added 
14) Companion cube added
15) The range of the radio has been increased (Test Chamber 3) 
16) [u]Skip voice lines under certain conditions added (Death)[/u] 
17) Download DEMO button added to full game store page 
18) The wire is moved by someone (Test Chamber 4) 
19) The natural test chamber was lowered by 75 centimeters. (29.5278290551 inches) (Test chamber 4) 20) [u]Refractor glass now has distinguishing marks from regular glass[/u] 
21) Added information about losing progress when gv_cheats ON (help gv_cheasts) 
22) The wire is moved by someone (Test Chamber 4)[/p][p][/p][h2]Optimization[/h2][p]
23) [u]The island is significantly optimized
[/u]24) Additional redistributable components have been added (Visual C++ Redist 2022 + .NET 3.5). This may improve game performance. 
25) Added Shader Warmup (console command: db_warmupAllShaders) May reduce the amount of stutters (using the same command can disable this option)
26) Optimized Player Utilities 
27) All maps now have [u]Occlusion Culling

[/u]
Dont forget to wishlist the full game on Steam and report any bugs![/p]
